title: User agent is a local daemon serving plaintext JMAP Chat
description: mimid-agent runs on the user's machine: does MLS and holds keys; outward speaks JMAP Chat E2EE mode + mimid MLS capability to the provider; inward serves plaintext JMAP Chat on a user-only unix socket (0600; bearer token required if TCP is ever used). Agent decodes mimi-content into JMAP Message views (senderMsgId per R1). UIs (TUI, any JMAP Chat app, later GUI) are thin JMAP Chat clients. Rejected: MLS library embedded in each client (every future client must embed the Rust core). Precedent: Matrix pantalaimon.
